edits.old: Under `C-POL-3`, do not invent a guard check or silently substitute manifest objects/hashes: when minting 15-key `security` and `nonsecurity` receipts and Root `ADMITTED_CONFIGURATION`, Root must bind `source_manifest_sha256` consistently across both receipts and verify equality with `c['source_manifest']['sha256']` (`9f48d1f227c2714bab374828b7fe4dd930aab660ea63dd2685f91d6250bcafce`, `source-manifest.proposal.json`) or `SOURCE-FREEZE.json` (`f7910a648f0558c9aa3f0543c18cc546d0b0238c83b867db75c2ff0dfb3cdf17`). Owner convention resolution: lock receipt `source_manifest_sha256` in both review receipts to a single declared convention—canonically `c['source_manifest']['sha256']` (`9f48d1f2...`, matching config field `source_manifest`) or `SOURCE-FREEZE.json` (`f7910a64...`, the 12-file R53 runner/test freeze) as explicitly stated in Root's admission record—and require Root at `ADMITTED_CONFIGURATION` minting to externally verify **both** manifest namespaces (`records['security']['source_manifest_sha256'] == records['nonsecurity']['source_manifest_sha256']` equal to the declared digest `9f48d1f2...` or `f7910a64...`, `c['source_manifest']['sha256'] == 9f48d1f2...` bound in `config_inputs_sha256`, and `SOURCE-FREEZE.json == f7910a64...` bound with `runner_sha256 == 94810a65...`).
edits.new: Under C-POL-3, bounded_sdk_compile.py:consent() (94810a65a2a68563300edefe34c76447ad9cc3118c07c8ae8f67607b88ac1fd7) and decision-records.schema.json (2cf9726b8b21b74cb4fe708e45d6e54a6ed40564dbeeefdee3951cb6ef263614) check only that records['security']['source_manifest_sha256'] and records['nonsecurity']['source_manifest_sha256'] are 64-hex digests equal to each other without directly comparing them to c['source_manifest']['sha256']. Without altering guard/schema bytes or claiming nonexistent guard enforcement, both records['security']['source_manifest_sha256'] and records['nonsecurity']['source_manifest_sha256'] must contain the single SDK checkout full-source manifest digest c['source_manifest']['sha256'] = 9f48d1f227c2714bab374828b7fe4dd930aab660ea63dd2685f91d6250bcafce (/home/charl/Moriarty/.moriarty-dev/runtime/sherlock-reference-20261015/opus-sprint-loop-20261015/astra-a102-compile-subject-prep-r1/source-manifest.proposal.json), paired with subject_manifest_sha256 = c['bindings']['subject']['sha256'] = 68620a2a2462411050860503128193f32250f9165ce4ec80346da195cd4f157b (COMPILE-SUBJECT.json) and runner_sha256 = c['bindings']['runner']['sha256'] = 94810a65a2a68563300edefe34c76447ad9cc3118c07c8ae8f67607b88ac1fd7 (bounded_sdk_compile.py). When minting ADMITTED_CONFIGURATION, Root must externally verify that both review receipts bind source_manifest_sha256 == c['source_manifest']['sha256'] == 9f48d1f227c2714bab374828b7fe4dd930aab660ea63dd2685f91d6250bcafce (anchored in config_inputs_sha256) and separately verify the external R53 12-file guard/schema/test/doc/driver freeze artifact /home/charl/Moriarty/.moriarty-dev/runtime/sherlock-review-20261017/53-r2-integrated-source-candidate/source/SOURCE-FREEZE.json == f7910a648f0558c9aa3f0543c18cc546d0b0238c83b867db75c2ff0dfb3cdf17 alongside runner_sha256 == 94810a65a2a68563300edefe34c76447ad9cc3118c07c8ae8f67607b88ac1fd7.
